apis.name: CcspHalEthSwInit
apis.brief: Initializes the Ethernet Switch (EthSW) HAL. This function sets up the necessary resources and configurations for the EthSW HAL to function.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On successful initialization. RETURN_ERR - On failure (check for specific error details).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortStatus
apis.signature: INT CcspHalEthSwGetPortStatus(CCSP_HAL_ETHSW_PORT PortId, PCCSP_HAL_ETHSW_LINK_RATE pLinkRate, PCCSP_HAL_ETHSW_DUPLEX_MODE pDuplexMode, PCCSP_HAL_ETHSW_LINK_STATUS pStatus);
apis.brief: Retrieves the status information for a specified Ethernet switch port. This function fetches the link rate, duplex mode, and link status of the given port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, retrieval error).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg
apis.signature: INT CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg(CCSP_HAL_ETHSW_PORT PortId, PCCSP_HAL_ETHSW_LINK_RATE pLinkRate, PCCSP_HAL_ETHSW_DUPLEX_MODE pDuplexMode);
apis.brief: Retrieves the configuration of a specified Ethernet switch port. This function fetches the configured link rate and duplex mode of the given port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, retrieval error).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg
apis.signature: INT CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg(CCSP_HAL_ETHSW_PORT PortId, CCSP_HAL_ETHSW_LINK_RATE LinkRate, CCSP_HAL_ETHSW_DUPLEX_MODE DuplexMode);
apis.brief: Configures the link rate and duplex mode for a specific Ethernet switch port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, invalid configuration values).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus
apis.brief: Retrieves the administrative status of a specified Ethernet switch port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, retrieval error).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortAdminStatus
apis.brief: Sets the administrative status of a specific Ethernet switch port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, invalid admin status value).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwSetAgingSpeed
apis.brief: Sets the aging speed for the specified Ethernet switch port. This function configures the aging speed for a given port on the Ethernet switch. The aging speed determines how long a MAC address entry remains in the switch's forwarding table without receiving traffic.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, invalid aging speed value).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwLocatePortByMacAddress
apis.brief: Locates the port associated with a given MAC address on a MoCA or Ethernet switch. This function searches for a specific MAC address in the MoCA or Ethernet switch's MAC address tables. - 0: MoCA port - 1-4: Ethernet port
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success (MAC address found and port stored in `port`). RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., MAC address not found, invalid input parameters).

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_getAssociatedDevice
apis.brief: Retrieves information about associated Ethernet devices. This function populates an array with details of connected devices and returns the array size. **Important:** The HAL allocates memory for the device array (`output_struct`). The caller is responsible for freeing this memory.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointers, memory allocation issues, or retrieval errors).

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_ethAssociatedDevice_callback_register
apis.brief: Registers a callback function for Ethernet client association/disassociation events.

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_ethPortConfigure
apis.brief: Configures an Ethernet port for WAN functionality. This function enables or disables the Ethernet WAN feature on a specific port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid interface name, configuration error).

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanEnable
apis.brief: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN enable status. - true (1): Ethernet WAN is enabled. - false (0): Ethernet WAN is disabled.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointer).

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanEnable
apis.brief: Enables or disables Ethernet WAN functionality. - true (1): Enable Ethernet WAN. - false (0): Disable Ethernet WAN.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure.

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_getCurrentWanHWConf
apis.brief: Retrieves the current hardware (HW) WAN configuration status.
apis.return_doc: The current WAN HW configuration status: TRUE - WAN is enabled. FALSE - LAN is enabled.

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanPort
apis.brief: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN port number. This function retrieves the numerical index of the Ethernet port currently configured for WAN functionality.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid pointer, retrieval error).

apis.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanPort
apis.brief: Sets the Ethernet WAN interface/port number. This function configures which Ethernet port will be used for the WAN connection.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port number, configuration error).

apis.name: CcspHalEthSwGetEthPortStats
apis.brief: Retrieves statistics for a specified Ethernet switch port. This function populates the provided structure with various statistics about the specified Ethernet switch port.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid port ID, retrieval error).

apis.name: GWP_RegisterEthWan_Callback
apis.brief: Registers RDKB callback functions for Ethernet WAN events.

apis.name: GWP_GetEthWanLinkStatus
apis.brief: Retrieves the current status of the Ethernet WAN (EthWAN) link.
apis.return_doc: Status of the EthWAN link: 1 - Link is up (active). 0 - Link is down (inactive). < 0 - Error occurred (check errno for details).

apis.name: GWP_GetEthWanInterfaceName
apis.brief: Retrieves the name of the Ethernet WAN (EthWAN) interface. This function populates the provided buffer with the name of the currently active EthWAN interface.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointer, insufficient buffer size).
